newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Guangzhou Power plans 100 mln A share offer.
newsitem.headline: China Guangzhou Power plans 100 mln A share offer.

text.p: Guangzhou Electric Power Enterprise Group Co Ltd, whose assets are being restructured, plans to launch an initial public offering of 100 million A shares this year, a company official said on Wednesday.

The firm would file an application on the offer with the China Securities Regulatory Commission in the near future but had not decided whether to list on the Shanghai or the Shenzhen bourse, the official told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.
Guangzhou Securities Co Ltd would be the main underwriter for the issue, he said.

The company plans to use the proceeds to continue construction of a 3.5-billion yuan power plant, the official said. The plant will have two generators, each with a capacity of 300,000 kw, and is scheduled for completion by end-1997.
When it goes into full operation, the plant could generate three billion kw hours of electricity annually, he said.
Based in Guangzhou, capital of Guangdong province, Guangzhou Electric currently has two generators, each with a capacity of 300,000 kw, the official said.
